definitions.explanation: Sleeves that end above the elbow, or a garment with such sleeves. Standard summer clothing vocabulary.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{暑|あつ}い→暑い：00619_atsui⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{半袖|はんそで}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦しよう→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: It's hot today, so let's go with short sleeves.

examples.japanese: {半袖|はんそで}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{寒|さむ}い→寒い：00664_samui⟧⟦かもしれない→かもしれない：00164_kamoshirenai⟧。
examples.english: Short sleeves might be too cold.

examples.japanese: ⟦まだ→まだ：00603_mada⟧⟦{四月|しがつ}→四月：00668_shigatsu⟧な⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{半袖|はんそで}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{歩|ある}いている→歩く：00538_aruku⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧がいて⟦{驚|おどろ}いた→驚く：01255_odoroku⟧。
examples.english: I was surprised to see people walking around in short sleeves even though it's only April.

notes:
USAGE:
{半袖|はんそで} is everyday clothing vocabulary. When discussing what to wear based on the weather or season, {半袖|はんそで} and ⟦{長袖|ながそで}→長袖：15517_nagasode⟧ are the standard pair.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {半袖|はんそで}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦シャツ→シャツ：01052_shatsu⟧ (short-sleeved shirt)
- {半袖|はんそで}Tシャツ (short-sleeved T-shirt)
- {半袖|はんそで}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{出|で}かける→出かける：00833_dekakeru⟧ (to go out in short sleeves)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{長袖|ながそで}→長袖：15517_nagasode⟧: long sleeves
- ⟦{袖|そで}→袖：02217_sode⟧: sleeve
- ⟦{袖|そで}なし→袖なし：23859_sodenashi⟧: sleeveless
